packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Offset is a zero-based record offset; part selects a large exact-record fragment. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience.
